## Scope

Describe the problem, the exact behavior changed, and the linked issue or AEP.

## Evidence

List tests, schemas, fixtures, and artifacts that verify the change. Identify
all numerical values as measured, simulated, estimated, or assumed.

## Checklist

- [ ] I ran the documented local checks that apply to this change.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for observable behavior.
- [ ] I updated schemas, compatibility notes, and documentation together.
- [ ] I added a changelog entry for user-visible behavior.
- [ ] I committed no generated artifact, credential, or proprietary material.
- [ ] Every public quantitative claim links to immutable reproducible evidence.
